dispatch_generation.meaning: M1 attempts already consumed; distinguishes authorized retry route references

hard_filters: quota_status is available with a fresh finite observation
selection_policy.capacity_semantics: source_status=available requires the source router to establish route capacity; capacity_unknown and capacity_exhausted are blocked states; reserved source_reason_codes capacity_unknown, capacity_exhausted and cooldown_active block even when source_status contradicts them; M1 free_slots remains a separate global bound
selection_policy.provider_inventory_source: existing bt_agents.candidates; no second provider catalog

route_identity.serialization: utf-8 canonical JSON; NFC strings; sorted keys; compact separators
route_identity.account_ref: acct:<sha256 of existing bt_agents.account_key>; raw account key and profile environment are never persisted

idempotency.changed_snapshot: persist a new decision linked by plan_id and task_id

decision_ledger.write_input: original DecisionRequest; revalidated on persistence; ValidatedRequest rejected because redacted evidence normalization is not reversible
decision_ledger.storage: dedicated SQLite file; application_id M2DE; schema version 3; WAL; synchronous FULL
decision_ledger.transaction: BEGIN IMMEDIATE; unique idempotency key; exact replay returns original record
decision_ledger.previous_link_order: latest inserted decision for the same plan_id and task_id
decision_ledger.at_capacity: reject new decisions; never prune history
decision_ledger.schema_1_migration: writable opens migrate additively through schema 2 learning_snapshots to schema 3 batch_decisions without rewriting existing records; read-only schema-1 opens remain valid
decision_ledger.schema_2_migration: writable opens add the immutable batch_decisions table without rewriting decision_records or learning_snapshots; read-only schema-2 opens remain valid
decision_ledger.rationale: semicolon-joined values from decision_record.factor_code_values; free text forbidden
decision_ledger.executor_resolution: only persisted selected route; read-only lookup

batch_decision.input_fingerprint: SHA-256 over normalized per-task requests, route-policy evidence, per-route quota evidence, route policy, explicit account concurrency, per-task baseline-preservation flags and batch algorithm version
batch_decision.batch_id: SHA-256 over batch algorithm version and input fingerprint
batch_decision.exclusion_reasons: existing hard-filter reason codes plus quality_floor_not_met and quality_evidence_insufficient
batch_decision.redaction: stores task IDs, profile identifiers, opaque route/account references, quota status facts, reasons and hashes; never stores task briefs, raw route-policy evidence or provider output
batch_decision.compatibility: new readers decode legacy 1.2.0 batch payloads as immutable records with empty quota_evidence; new 1.3.0 records are additive JSON payloads in the existing append-only table; old binaries cannot decode 1.3.0 rows and must use v1 fingerprints or a pre-change ledger backup
batch_decision.rollback: roll back the writer to batch algorithm v1 using v1 fingerprints; retain both record versions and the append-only table; do not rewrite or delete records
batch_decision.immutability: append-only; exact input replay returns the first verified payload; updates and deletes are rejected
batch_decision.integrity_check: plan_sha256 covers the canonical immutable payload; malformed or corrupted plans fail closed
batch_decision.at_capacity: reject new batch decisions; never prune existing records

shadow_comparison.disabled_behavior: return before inspecting requests, route evidence or capacity and before running either planner
shadow_comparison.baseline: rank_candidates hard filters and router rank in supplied READY order, respecting the same free_slots and explicit effective-account concurrency
shadow_comparison.proposed_policy: plan_ready_batch over the exact same normalized requests, route evidence, policy configuration and capacity snapshot
shadow_comparison.snapshot_fingerprint: SHA-256 over API and shadow policy versions, plan snapshot, READY order, normalized request hashes, route evidence, route policy and explicit account concurrency
shadow_comparison.comparison_fingerprint: SHA-256 over snapshot fingerprint, complete baseline assignments/exclusions/no-assignment results, proposed BatchPlan and stable per-task comparisons

learning_snapshot.source_fingerprint: SHA-256 over API version, policy, learning cutoff, route, allowlisted target context, normalized T9 event hashes, normalized context identity hashes and contextual aggregate
learning_snapshot.integrity_check: snapshot_sha256 covers the canonical immutable payload; malformed or corrupted snapshots fail closed
learning_snapshot.redaction: raw events and plan/revision/task/attempt identities are hashed into the fingerprint and are not stored
learning_snapshot.immutability: append-only; exact source replay returns the first payload and timestamp; update/delete are rejected
learning_snapshot.at_capacity: reject new snapshots; never prune existing snapshots
learning_snapshot.cutoff_rule: caller supplies only facts available at learning_cutoff; the cutoff participates in the source fingerprint

decision_record.quota_evidence: finite observation epoch, measured used percentage, and finite validity deadline copied from the eligible candidate; M3 refuses missing or expired evidence at route resolution and immediately before launch

quota_observation.window_contract: Each caller-declared relevant window must have one fresh observation scoped to the same effective account, provider and model; missing or unknown windows never imply capacity; exhausted windows block
quota_observation.pressure: maximum used_percent across every required fresh available window
quota_observation.reset_rule: Claude null resets are usable only when the source explicitly allows unknown resets; Codex and Antigravity require a reported reset after now
quota_observation.source_status_rule: Only source_status=ok can produce available or exhausted; every other cache source status remains unknown

attribution_requirements: same effective account, provider, model, source and window
ordered cached readings with overlapping validity
one active task and explicit evidence that external usage is absent
same reported reset time after the second observation
quota_demand.contamination_result: unknown with attribution_unknown; never emit a quota delta
quota_demand.estimate_range: empirical min/median/max; not a confidence interval or calibrated forecast

verified_history_requires: attempt, decision and verdict plan/revision/task identities match
attempt reference names the decision and its selected route
M1 application status is applied or duplicate
independent non-empty verifier differs from the attempt executor label
accepted verdict matches accepted attempt state and has evidence
rejected verdict matches rejected attempt state
verdict has a timezone-aware timestamp recorded by M1 when it applied the verdict
attempt and verdict are explicitly non-synthetic
performance_event.stable_event_identity: sha256 of schema version, plan/revision/task/attempt identity and verdict_id when present; otherwise those identities and attempt state
performance_event.replay: deduplicate identical attempt/verdict projections; a later M1 application supersedes a prior rejected stale delivery of the same verdict; conflicting applied duplicates or multiple applied verdict ids for the same plan/revision/task/attempt become unknown independent of input order
performance_event.redaction: never emit verifier labels, accepted/verification text, raw provider output, task brief or credentials

performance_history.exact_context_match: same route, task_family, complexity, scope, risk and coupling; all dimensions must be known
performance_history.route_match: same selected route, context may be absent
performance_history.attempt_denominator: unique (plan_id, revision, task_id, attempt_id) identities assigned to the target route; includes nonquality outcomes
performance_history.coverage: verified_samples / attempt_count; null when attempt_count is zero
performance_history.uncertainty_interval_95: Wilson interval for the observed verified pass rate; descriptive only and not a future-outcome guarantee
performance_history.prior: Beta(2,2); shrunk feature is exposed for a selected level only when verified_samples >= minimum_verified_samples
performance_history.sparse_fallback: choose the first context level with at least five eligible samples; if no level qualifies, selected_level=baseline and selected_shrunk_feature=null

performance_temporal.cutoff_field: M1 applied_at on application_status=applied event, UTC epoch seconds
performance_temporal.training_rule: filter only application_status=applied records by applied_at <= cutoff, replay-reduce across all routes, then aggregate the selected route
performance_temporal.evaluation_rule: filter only application_status=applied records by applied_at > cutoff, replay-reduce across all routes, then aggregate the selected route for attempts not known at cutoff
performance_temporal.untimed_rule: exclude attempts without a valid M1-applied timestamp from training and evaluation; report the unique attempt count separately
performance_temporal.source_fingerprint: SHA-256 over only pre-cutoff reduced events across routes, their context identity hashes, route, target context, cutoff and historical aggregate
performance_temporal.future_metrics: observed counts/rates and descriptive Wilson intervals; future outcomes are absent from the historical feature and source fingerprint

batch_quota.profile_aliases: candidate routes sharing provider/account_ref reuse one quota assessment; budgets are never summed per profile
batch_quota.route_eligibility: available only when every declared base and model-specific window is fresh and available
batch_quota.missing_stale_unknown_or_exhausted_windo: route excluded with stable assessment state/reason
batch_quota.reset_rule: a short-window reset does not release an exhausted weekly or model-specific window

laya_invariants: value and accepted_cutoff are finite in [0,1]
deterministic_invariants: value is null or finite in [0,1]
confidence.semantics: choice acceptance calibration only; never real-world task-success probability

laya_quality_gate.calibration_rule: lowest answer_confidence cutoff with one-sided 95% Wilson accuracy lower bound >= deterministic calibration accuracy
laya_quality_gate.bootstrap_method: two-sided 95% paired percentile interval; case rows sorted by case_id; sample n paired outcomes with replacement per replicate using Python random.Random(seed).randrange(n); endpoints use nearest-rank ceil(q*B)-1; a zero lower bound does not pass

fixture_protocol.label_protocol_minimum: documented rubric and independent adjudication before model output is inspected

laya_quality_gate.evidence_authorization: A benchmark may authorize Laya only after its exact five-artifact digest is independently reviewed and added here; synthetic or locally modified metrics never self-authorize
